description: This file defines macros, data structures, and function prototypes related to Memory Management Unit (MMU) and page frame management in the Zephyr kernel, including demand paging support.

methods.name: z_page_frame_is_pinned
methods.description: Checks if a page frame is pinned (contains critical kernel data).

methods.name: z_page_frame_is_reserved
methods.description: Checks if a page frame is reserved by hardware.

methods.name: z_page_frame_is_mapped
methods.description: Checks if a page frame is mapped to virtual memory.

methods.name: z_page_frame_is_busy
methods.description: Checks if a page frame is involved in a page-in/out operation.

methods.name: z_page_frame_is_backed
methods.description: Checks if a page frame has a clean copy in backing store.

methods.name: z_page_frame_is_evictable
methods.description: Determines if a page frame can be evicted.

methods.name: z_page_frame_is_available
methods.description: Checks if a page frame is free and available for use.

methods.name: z_assert_phys_aligned
methods.description: Asserts that a physical address is page-aligned.

methods.name: z_page_frame_to_phys
methods.description: Converts a page frame pointer to its physical address.

methods.name: z_page_frame_to_virt
methods.description: Returns the virtual address mapped to a page frame.

methods.name: z_is_page_frame
methods.description: Checks if a physical address is within the physical RAM range and page-aligned.

methods.name: z_phys_to_page_frame
methods.description: Converts a physical address to its corresponding page frame structure.

methods.name: z_mem_assert_virtual_region
methods.description: Asserts that a virtual memory region is properly aligned and within range.
